# Add a real-pointer context-menu example and proof

## Context

Neo has inline Menu examples and a Button-owned floating menu example, but no permanent example for the common application pattern: open a floating menu from `onContextMenu` at the pointer coordinate. No Engine whitebox journey covers real right-click input, nested menu focus, outside-pointer dismissal, or viewport-edge placement.

A temporary complete Body example proved why the missing example matters:

- center placement through direct fixed `left/top` was exact;
- near `(1260,700)` in a `1280×720` viewport, the menu overflowed to `right=1361.63`, `bottom=789`;
- real nested submenu clicks were green on this machine, while a downstream report observed a load-sensitive root unmount;
- non-focusable outside clicks left both Menu and Picker open because focus did not move.

The permanent example is the consumer proof for the alignment and floating-dismissal prerequisites, not a place to reimplement them.

## The Problem

Developers currently have to infer five non-obvious pieces from unrelated sources: contextmenu default prevention, reusable Menu construction, pointer geometry, floating alignment, and focus/dismissal lifecycle. The predictable result is application-root listeners, direct coordinate styles, removed `parentComponent` links, synthetic-click false greens, and business-app-specific fixes.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/menu/` is the canonical Body example family. A complete `examples/menu/context/` app matches the existing `list/` and `panel/` structure.
- The example consumes serialized point alignment from [#17824](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17824) and pointer-complete Menu dismissal from [#17825](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17825).
- Context menus are not Button menus: they have no persistent trigger component. The pointer point is the alignment target, and the Menu's own outside-pointer contract owns dismissal.
- Whitebox E2E belongs at `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ContextMenuNL.spec.mjs`, beside `ButtonBaseNL.spec.mjs`.
- Physical behavior must use real Playwright mouse input. Synthetic `click`/`contextmenu` dispatch does not prove browser focus transitions.

## The Fix

Add a small, public `examples/menu/context/` application:

- one non-focusable workspace region and one naturally focusable item;
- `onContextMenu` creates/reuses one floating `Neo.menu.List` with nested and leaf actions;
- native context-menu default is prevented on the example surface;
- the Menu aligns to `{x: clientX, y: clientY, width: 0, height: 0}` with `edgeAlign: 't0-b0'`, `axisLock: true`, and viewport constraint;
- a visible status component records the selected leaf action without business-domain logic.

Add a whitebox journey that drives the real browser and asserts both rendered and worker truth.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge Case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| New `examples/menu/context/` | This ticket + existing Menu examples | Teach the minimal reusable right-click Menu pattern | No application root listener or direct `left/top` fallback | Example JSDoc and visible instructions | Browser + Neural Link journey |
| Pointer placement | [#17824](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17824) | Open at the pointer and stay fully inside the viewport through flip/constrain | Reopen at a new point updates the same Menu instance | Example code | Center + four-edge geometry assertions |
| Menu lifecycle | [#17825](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17825) | Nested real clicks stay open; leaf, Escape, focusable outside, and non-focusable outside paths settle correctly | No wall-clock sleeps as correctness assertions | Example code | Worker state + activeElement + DOM presence |
| Real-input evidence | Whitebox E2E protocol | Use `page.mouse` right/left clicks and keyboard Escape, then assert Engine state via Neural Link | Synthetic event dispatch is not accepted as the only positive path | Spec comments only | Exact custom E2E command |

## Decision Record impact

`none` — this adds a canonical consumer and executable documentation for existing Engine components.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Complete Body example exists under `examples/menu/context/` and passes the examples Body-only/build guards.
- [ ] Real right-click opens one reusable Menu at the pointer; the native browser menu is suppressed only on the example surface.
- [ ] Center placement is exact, and top/right/bottom/left edge probes keep the full Menu inside the viewport using alignment flip/constrain.
- [ ] Real first- and second-level submenu clicks keep the full menu tree mounted and focus the intended item.
- [ ] A leaf action updates worker-owned example state and dismisses according to Menu policy.
- [ ] Escape, focusable outside click, and non-focusable outside click dismiss; inside clicks do not.
- [ ] Reopening at a different point reuses the Menu instance and updates geometry without stale submenus or listeners.
- [ ] Whitebox proof asserts App-worker component state plus DOM/focus geometry; no synthetic-only positive path and no blind correctness sleep.

## Out of Scope

- Business permissions, editor commands, occurrence search, delete-key behavior, or any downstream application code.
- A context-menu framework subclass, application controller scaffold, guide archaeology, or multiple demo variants.
- Touch long-press, OS-native menus, or custom animation design.
- Fixing alignment or dismissal inside the example PR; it consumes the prerequisite contracts.

## Avoided Traps

- **Copying the downstream workaround:** would publish application ownership for framework behavior.
- **Synthetic-click proof:** misses the exact real-focus failure class.
- **Oversized studio demo:** obscures the reusable menu contract behind product code.
